correctness.rationale: TARGET disproof verified step by step. Freeness: Fix(S^m) finite hence null for m!=0; rotation fixed-point-free for n!=0. Ergodicity: (1,0)-invariance plus ergodicity of S forces z-measurability, then (0,1)-invariance plus ergodicity of R forces constancy. Spectral singularity: ONB {g_jx1}x{1xe_k}x{g_jxe_k} has each spectral measure supported on the fixed null set N=TxE, E={k alpha} countable, so any maximal spectral type lives on N and is singular vs Lebesgue on T^2; m_Txdelta_0 embedding is the correct mechanism. Kronecker=rotation: Fourier eigenfunction argument using weak mixing of S leaves at most one surviving k, so eigenfunctions are z-measurable; rotation characters give equality. Z_<2=rotation: relative product YxYxZ with SxSxR is ergodic (SxS ergodic since S weakly mixing), so X->Z is relatively weakly mixing; with the admitted premise that Z_<2->Z_<1=Kronecker is a distal tower step, the Furstenberg-Zimmer no-intermediate-distal fact forces Z_<2=Z. Joining lambda=lambda_Yxmu_Z^3 is diagonal-invariant with all three 2D marginals muxmu; f(y,z)=(-1)^{y_0} has mean 0 hence E[f|Z_<2]=0, while triple integral is 1 since a+b+(a+b mod 2) is always even. Simulation re-ran OK. Relied-upon distal-tower/FZ facts are standard black boxes explicitly cited.

The 2D-singularity-hosts-1D-Lebesgue mechanism plus Bernstein lift plus Z_<2=rotation identification is not stated or implied by any prior source found.

value.rationale: TARGET-route rigorous disproof of the admitted relative-independence-over-Z_<2 conjecture. Object is natural (product of the fair Bernoulli shift and an irrational rotation, the two most classical systems) and motivated before computation; the failure mechanism is structural (2D singularity does not exclude m_Txdelta_0 behaviour hosting a Bernstein pairwise-independent triple-correlated joining in one coordinate), not a type/normalization error, vacuity, tiny-instance mismatch, lookup, or arbitrary parameter fact. Eligible finding form: counterexample changing a classification boundary, with an honest scope limitation (nontrivial-Z_<2 case refuted; trivial-Z_<2 subcase left open) and a sharpness remark guiding repair. Independently worth retrieving for joinings / PID / Host-Kra research.
